list.title: Campaigns
list.empty: No campaigns yet. A campaign groups the tagged variants of your links so you can read their clicks together.

gated.title: Read every channel of a campaign in one place
gated.body: Campaigns group the tagged variants of your links: their clicks on one page, a UTM builder with your defaults, and CSV export.

overview.created: Campaign created. Tag a link for it in the UTM builder.
overview.noData: No visits in the last 30 days.
overview.linksHint: A link joins when one of its UTM variants uses this campaign.
overview.noLinks: No links in this campaign yet. Build a tagged URL and save it as a variant.
overview.deleteHint: Its variants are removed from the links; the links keep working.
overview.variantsSaved: {count, plural, one {# variant saved} other {# variants saved}}. {skipped} already saved variants skipped.

form.newDescription: Name it the way it should read as utm_campaign in your analytics. You'll tag links for it next.
form.editDescription: Title, description and the values the UTM builder suggests.
form.title: Title
form.titleHint: Used as utm_campaign in the URLs you tag.
form.renameHint: Saved variants switch to the new title. URLs you've already shared keep the old one, and their clicks stop counting here.

defaults.title: UTM defaults
defaults.description: Values the builder suggests for this campaign. They're saved in lowercase.

hints.sources: Where the traffic comes from, like newsletter or instagram.
hints.mediums: The kind of channel, like email or social.
hints.contents: What tells links in the same place apart, like header or footer.

placeholders.sources: Type a source and press Enter
placeholders.mediums: Type a medium and press Enter
placeholders.terms: Type a term and press Enter
placeholders.contents: Type a value and press Enter

builder.description: Tag selected short links for one channel. utm_campaign is always this campaign's title.
builder.notInCampaign: This link isn't in the campaign yet. Saving the variant adds it; until then its clicks don't count here.
builder.pickLinkFirst: Choose a link to build its URL.
builder.saveHint: Saving adds the same UTM values to each selected link and includes its clicks in this campaign.
builder.linkHint: Browse by tags or search, then choose one or more short links to tag.
builder.previewMany: Preview for the first selected link. These UTM values apply to every selected link.

deletePage.title: Delete campaign
deletePage.variants: {count, plural, =0 {No link carries its UTM variants yet.} one {Its UTM variants are removed from # link.} other {Its UTM variants are removed from # links.}}
deletePage.analytics: URLs already shared with its utm_campaign keep their clicks, but no campaign page shows them.
deletePage.permanent: The UTM defaults are deleted with it.

errors.titleTaken: Another campaign already has this title.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this in this workspace.
errors.notFound: This campaign or link no longer exists. It may have been deleted.
errors.invalidInput: Some fields are too long or not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
errors.duplicate: This variant is already saved on the link.
errors.partial: Saved variants on {count} links before the remaining saves failed. Retry to continue; already saved variants are skipped.

library.title: Choose campaign links
library.results: {count, plural, one {# matching link} other {# matching links}}
library.hint: Selections stay across pages and filters. Choose up to 500 links per save.
library.failed: Could not load links. Retry without losing your selection.
library.empty: No matching links. Change your filters or search.
